independent_server_review.assessment: Native transport keeps raw capability at Cloudflare composition, preserves closed shell factories/policy and native response metadata, releases native locks on successful end/read failure/overflow/deadline/interruption, and removes abort listeners. MCP deliberately joins cancellation before resident lease release; scoped tests prove normal/refused/shared cancellation lifetime. Email tests prove refusal and no partial receipt/R2 storage after overflow. Skipping empty chunks and iterative WorkersAI collection avoid unbounded reference retention and quadratic copying. Final interruption changes preserve existing native started-write policies and retain the existing canonical D1 batch/readback mask. They stop later queue/coordinator handoffs after cancellation, leave ambiguous workflow creation and coordinator fetch unacknowledged, and preserve ordinary failure reconciliation. Optional AI layer construction now preserves interruption and defects rather than reporting absence. No new mask or provider/create replay was introduced.
interruption_test_evidence: New WhatsApp test observes one started native coordinator fetch, interrupt exit, no ack/retry on either message, and no second same-User fetch
